stages.name: Pike foundation
stages.work: Pike push-ups, feet on floor → feet elevated; wrist prep; scapular shrugs; hollow hold
ready: 3 × 10 feet-elevated pike push-ups, hips over hands

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back. Warm the wrists before pressing.

exercises.name: Pike push-up (feet on floor)
exercises.cue: Hips high over the hands; the head travels forward between the hands. Move the feet to a low box once 3 × 10 is clean.

exercises.name: Pike scapular shrugs
exercises.cue: Arms locked. Push the floor away and shrug the shoulders to the ears.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat, ribs tucked toward the pelvis.

stages.name: Wall handstand
stages.work: Chest-to-wall walk-ups and holds, line and breathing

stages.name: Negatives
stages.work: Wall HSPU negatives, 5 s lowering to a head-touch on a folded mat

stages.name: Partial range
stages.work: Wall HSPU to a mat stack, depth increasing as the stack shrinks (15 → 10 → 5 cm)

stages.name: Full range
stages.work: Wall HSPU, head to the floor, no mat

stages.name: Beyond the goal
stages.note: Outside the goal; only if you want it later
